title: Lab - Service networking
description: Trace a Service down to iptables.
scenario: Trace a Service down to iptables. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Ranges
tasks.instructions: What is the Pod CIDR and what is the Service CIDR of this cluster?
tasks.solution:
kubectl cluster-info dump | grep -m1 cluster-cidr
ps -ef | grep kube-apiserver | grep -o "service-cluster-ip-range=[^ ]*"

tasks.title: Task 2 - Proxy mode
tasks.instructions: Which mode is kube-proxy running in?
tasks.solution: kubectl logs -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-proxy | grep -i "proxy mode"

tasks.title: Task 3 - Rules
tasks.instructions: Find the iptables rules for the kubernetes Service.
